form.label: Impacted assets
form.description: Server by server: which CVEs are still open (Rapid7 still finds them), how many are Critical / Severe / new, when the server was last scanned, and what was fixed recently. Click a server for its open CVEs. Active servers only (INACTIVE / DECOMMISSION hidden). Refreshed hourly by "Rapid7 CVE - asset summary" from the daily findings collector.

condition.set: | join type=inner asset_id [search `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_vuln)` [| inputlookup r7_vuln_catalog_lookup | search cves_str="*$value$*" | fields vuln_id | rename vuln_id as search | format] | fields asset_id]
| join type=inner asset_id [search `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:software)` product="*$value$*" | stats count by asset_id | fields asset_id]

search.query: | inputlookup r7_asset_summary.csv | search cmdb_status="WORKING_ACTIVE" env_label="$f_env$" | where $f_sev$ | where (like(lower(hostname), lower("%$f_host$%")) OR like(ip, "%$f_host$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(appname,"")), lower("%$f_app$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(os,"")), lower("%$f_os$%")) $cve_join$ $sw_join$ | join type=left asset_id [search `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:scan_result" cve_result="CVE fixed" earliest=-30d | stats dc(cve) as fixed_30d by asset_id] | fillnull value=0 fixed_30d | eval ls=strptime(replace(last_scan,"Z",""),"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), days_since_scan=round((now()-ls)/86400,0) | eval scan_data=case(isnull(ls),"None", days_since_scan>7,"Stale: rescan to verify", true(),"OK") | sort 0 - critical - open
| where days_since_scan>7 OR isnull(days_since_scan) | stats count

single.title: CVEs fixed in last 30 days (verified by rescan)

panel.title: Servers with open CVEs (click a server for its open CVEs)

search.query: | table hostname ip env_label appname os open critical severe moderate new_30d cvss9 last_scan days_since_scan scan_data fixed_30d asset_id | rename new_30d as "new (30 d)" cvss9 as "CVSS 9+" fixed_30d as "fixed (30 d)"
| eval label=hostname." · ".env_label." · ".open." open" | table asset_id label

button.data-r7-confirm: Request a rescan of the selected servers?

p.span: Requests are recorded now; scans start once the 1.2.0 executor on the forwarder is installed.

search.query: | r7rescan hosts=$r_hosts|s$ only_hosts=true dryrun=false request_id=$launch_nonce|s$ launched_from="Impacted assets" reason="Verify fixes"
| r7scanstatus | search job_id=$job_id|s$ | table job_id status rapid7_scans servers created finished result

table.title: Per Rapid7 scan while running; per server (before / after) once finished

format.colorPalette: {"CVE fixed":#53A051,"Not vulnerable":#53A051,"Rescanned":#53A051,"Still vulnerable":#DC4E41,"Newly found":#DC4E41,"Not verified":#F8BE34,"Rescanned, no login":#F8BE34,"No Rapid7 check yet":#708794}

html.p: Requested: recorded, waiting for the executor (installed in 1.2.0). Running: Rapid7 is scanning. Finished: the before / after result for each server is shown above. Click the job ID for the full report on Scan jobs & reports.

search.query: `r7_latest(rapid7:vm:asset_vuln)` asset_id="$asset$" | `r7_av_fields` | stats count by vuln_ids | lookup r7_vuln_catalog_lookup vuln_id AS vuln_ids OUTPUT title component severity cvss_v3 published added cve_count cves_str | eval cve=if(tonumber(cve_count)>20, "ROLLUP (".cve_count." CVEs)", replace(cves_str,"\|",", ")) | search severity="$d_sev$" | where like(lower(coalesce(cve,"")), lower("%$d_cve$%")) AND like(lower(coalesce(component,"")), lower("%$d_sw$%")) AND coalesce(tonumber(cvss_v3),0)>=$d_cvss$ | eval published=substr(published,1,10), added=substr(added,1,10) | eval software=component, cve_link=if(like(cve,"ROLLUP%"), "", mvindex(split(cves_str,"|"),0)) | eval sw_link=if(match(coalesce(software,""), "^[A-Za-z]+-\d{4}[-:]\d+"), "", software) | table cve title software severity cvss_v3 published added vuln_ids cve_link sw_link | rename vuln_ids as rapid7_check | sort 0 - cvss_v3

html.p: First-found date, days open and Rapid7's fix for this server are added in 1.2.0. A CVE leaves this list only when a scan that logged in no longer finds it.

search.query: `r7_index` sourcetype="rapid7:vm:scan_result" asset_id="$asset$" cve_result="CVE fixed" | table _time job_id cve software version_before version_after version_change | sort 0 - _time
